thread:
ash: quick sync - we must pick a single handoff for billing tags. current ambiguity between "billing_hint" at ingest and post-enrich final key is causing duplicate logic in qstores.
tori: agree. options: 1) authoritative at ingest, 2) enrichers override, 3) reconciler finalizes.
ben: data: ~3.3% of envelopes change billing after enrich; those are high-cost tails.
yasmin: UX: surface a "near-live" number and a "final" number once reconciler runs. label final with finalized_at.
ash: proposal: keep billing_hint at top-level for low-latency, let enrichers write enriched_key+confidence, and run a daily reconciler to set final_key and provenance. default TTL = 12h for v1.
tori: add flat audit: last_change_by, last_change_reason, last_change_ts. finance needs that.
ben: metrics: reconciliations_applied, billing_change_rate, envelopes_without_hint. alert on >1% hourly spike.
yasmin: SDK: add obs.get_billing_key(span_id, prefer_final=false) helper to avoid heavy joins in UI.
infra-bot: reconciler-canary scheduled Monday 03:00 UTC behind flag obs.billing_handoff_v1 :gear:
ash: action items: ash PR for schema (+provenance fields), ben does reconciler prototype, tori docs + enterprise opt-in. I'll draft RFC addendum tonight.
